requirements.requirement: A musical artist's first name matches part of the name of a charity.
The charity is unrelated to the musical artist and was registered between 2000 and 2010 inclusive.
The musical artist died in a city.
The city where the musical artist died is in a country, and that city is 20 to 30 miles inclusive from the site of that country's deadliest aviation accident as of 2023.
The aviation accident occurred 15 years prior to the musical artist's accidental death.
The musical artist had a partner at the time of the musical artist's death.
That partner gave an interview in which the partner said that following the musical artist's death, the musical artist has become a direct reference to one of the musical artist's songs.
The title of the song referenced in the partner's statement is one word and an adjective.
The requested song title is the title of that song.
